name: Morpho
description: Permissionless lending: Morpho Blue is one immutable contract holding isolated variable-rate markets (one loan token, one collateral token, an oracle, an IRM and a fixed LLTV each); curated ERC-4626 vaults (Vault V1 'MetaMorpho' and Vault V2) spread deposits across markets. Agents can lend or borrow directly in a market, deposit into a vault, use Bundles for one-transaction flows, and read everything via the public Morpho Read API.

contracts.name: Morpho (Morpho Blue singleton, variable-rate markets)

keyFunctions.description: Lend the loan token to one market: (marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, data). Set exactly one of assets/shares (other 0); data = empty bytes (non-empty triggers an onMorphoSupply callback). approve(Morpho, assets) on the loan token first. MarketParams = (loanToken, collateralToken, oracle, irm, lltv); lltv scaled by 1e18 (e.g. 860000000000000000 = 86%). Get it from idToMarketParams(marketId) or the Read API.

Withdraw lent assets: (marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, receiver). One of assets/shares non-zero; to exit fully pass shares = position(id,user).supplyShares. Reverts if the market lacks liquidity (utilisation 100%). Caller must be onBehalf or authorized by it.
Deposit collateral (not lent out, earns no interest): (marketParams, assets, onBehalf, data=empty). approve(Morpho) on the collateral token first.

Borrow the loan token: (marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, receiver). Position LTV must stay below the market's LLTV (collateral valued with the market oracle). Caller must be onBehalf or authorized (setAuthorization).

Repay debt: (marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, data=empty). To repay fully pass shares = position(id,user).borrowShares (assets would leave dust as interest accrues). approve(Morpho) on the loan token first; anyone can repay for anyone.
Withdraw collateral: (marketParams, assets, onBehalf, receiver). Reverts if the position would become unhealthy.

(marketId, user) -> (supplyShares, borrowShares, collateral). Collateral in token units; convert shares to assets with market(): assets = shares * (totalAssets + 1) / (totalShares + 1e6) (round up for borrow).

marketId -> (totalSupplyAssets, totalSupplyShares, totalBorrowAssets, totalBorrowShares, lastUpdate, fee). Values exclude interest accrued since lastUpdate; call accrueInterest or use the Read API for live numbers.
marketId -> (loanToken, collateralToken, oracle, irm, lltv). marketId = keccak256(abi.encode(marketParams)).
Let another address (e.g. a bundler or manager contract) manage your positions: borrow / withdraw / withdrawCollateral on your behalf. Revoke with false.
(authorizer, authorized) -> bool.
Accrue interest on a market so market()/position() reads are up to date.
Liquidate an unhealthy borrower (LTV > LLTV): (marketParams, borrower, seizedAssets, repaidShares, data). Set one of seizedAssets/repaidShares. Liquidation incentive depends on LLTV (max 15%).
Free flash loan of any token Morpho holds: (token, assets, data); caller must implement onMorphoFlashLoan and approve repayment.
Permissionless market creation with a governance-enabled IRM and LLTV. Markets are immutable once created.

contracts.name: AdaptiveCurveIrm (governance-approved interest rate model)
VaultV2Factory (Morpho Vault V2)

keyFunctions.description: Deploy a Morpho Vault V2: (owner, asset, salt). For curators.
True if the address is a Vault V2 deployed by this factory. Verify a vault with this before depositing.
[Called on a Vault V2, not on the factory] ERC-4626 deposit: (assets, onBehalf). approve(vault) first. Reverts if a gate blocks the caller.

[On a Vault V2] Withdraw an exact asset amount: (assets, receiver, onBehalf). Served from idle assets and the liquidity adapter; reverts if not enough liquidity (use forceDeallocate or VaultExitBundlesV1).
[On a Vault V2] Burn shares: (shares, receiver, onBehalf).

[On a Vault V2] Assets returned for shares now. Note: Vault V2 maxDeposit/maxMint/maxWithdraw/maxRedeem always return 0 by design (gates make them unpredictable), so do not use them to size withdrawals; use previewRedeem and the Read API's withdrawable_assets.
[On a Vault V2] Total assets under management.
[On a Vault V2] Non-custodial exit: (adapter, data, assets, onBehalf) pulls assets out of an adapter into idle so they can be withdrawn, paying the adapter's forceDeallocatePenalty in shares.

contracts.name: MetaMorpho Factory V1.1 (Morpho Vault V1)

keyFunctions.description: Deploy a Vault V1 (MetaMorpho v1.1): (initialOwner, initialTimelock, asset, name, symbol, salt). For curators; agents normally only deposit into existing vaults.
True if the address is a vault created by this factory. Use it to verify a vault before depositing.

[Called on a Vault V1 created by this factory, not on the factory] ERC-4626 deposit: (assets, receiver). approve(vault, assets) on the vault asset first. Assets are supplied to the curator's Morpho Blue markets following the supply queue.
[On a Vault V1] ERC-4626 withdraw an exact asset amount: (assets, receiver, owner). Limited by liquidity in the underlying markets.
[On a Vault V1] Burn shares for assets: (shares, receiver, owner). Use balanceOf(you) as shares to exit fully.
[On a Vault V1] Max assets the owner can withdraw now (bounded by underlying market liquidity).
[On a Vault V1] Asset value of shares (share price).

contracts.name: MetaMorpho Factory [OLD] (Vault V1.0)

keyFunctions.description: True for Vault V1.0 vaults created by this older factory.

contracts.name: Blue Public Allocator (Vault V2)

keyFunctions.description: Move a Vault V2's liquidity between Blue markets so you can borrow/withdraw where liquidity is short: (vault, deallocateAdapter, deallocateMarketParams, allocateAdapter, allocateMarketParams, assets, penalty). Pass penalty = vaultData(vault).penalty; if non-zero, approve this contract for the penalty amount in the vault asset first. Subject to the vault's caps set in this contract.
Allocate a Vault V2's idle assets to a market: (vault, adapter, marketParams, assets, penalty). Only if vaultData(vault).canPullFromIdle.
vault -> (canPullFromIdle, penalty). penalty is WAD-scaled (1e18 = 100%).
(vault, allocationId) -> cap for allocations through the Public Allocator; allocationId = keccak256(abi.encode("this/marketParams", adapter, marketParams)).
(vault, allocationId) -> whether liquidity may be pulled from that market.

contracts.name: BlueBundlesV1 (one-tx Morpho Blue actions)

keyFunctions.description: Supply loan assets to a market in one tx: (marketParams, assets, loanTokenPermit, referralFeePct, referralFeeRecipient, deadline). loanTokenPermit empty (kind 0, data 0x) = you approved this contract beforehand; otherwise an ERC-2612 or Permit2 signature. referralFeePct WAD-scaled (0 = none). Payable per ABI.

One-click borrow: (marketParams, collateralAssets, borrowAssets, maxLtv, collateralPermit, signedAuthorization, reallocations, referralFeePct, referralFeeRecipient, deadline). Reverts if resulting LTV > maxLtv (WAD). signedAuthorization = Morpho setAuthorizationWithSig for this contract (empty signature if already authorized). reallocations = optional Public Allocator moves to source liquidity.

(marketParams, repayAssets, repayShares, maxRepayAssets, collateralAssets, maxLtv, loanTokenPermit, signedAuthorization, referralFeePct, referralFeeRecipient, deadline). Repay by assets or shares (one of them), then withdraw collateral, checking maxLtv.

(marketParams, withdrawAssets, withdrawShares, signedAuthorization, reallocations, referralFeePct, referralFeeRecipient, deadline). Withdraw lent assets, optionally pulling public-allocator liquidity first.

Move a whole borrow position (collateral + debt) to another market with the same loan/collateral tokens: (sourceMarketParams, destMarketParams, maxLtv, signedAuthorization, reallocations, referralFeePct, referralFeeRecipient, deadline).

contracts.name: VaultBundlesV1 (one-tx vault deposit/withdraw/migrate)

keyFunctions.description: Deposit into a Vault V1 or V2: (vault, assets, maxSharePriceE27, assetPermit, referralFeePct, referralFeeRecipient, deadline). maxSharePriceE27 = slippage guard on share price (assets per share scaled 1e27). Empty permit = prior ERC-20 approval to this contract.
(vault, assets, shares, sharesPermit, referralFeePct, referralFeeRecipient, deadline). Withdraw by assets or shares; needs a share allowance to this contract or an ERC-2612 share permit.
(sourceVault, destVault, assetsWithdrawn, sharesRedeemed, destMaxSharePriceE27, sharesPermit, referralFeePct, referralFeeRecipient, deadline). E.g. Vault V1 to its V2 successor in one tx.

contracts.name: VaultExitBundlesV1 (exits from illiquid vaults)

keyFunctions.description: Exit an illiquid Vault V2 whose underlying markets are liquid, paying the force-deallocate penalty (idle and liquidity-adapter assets first, penalty-free).
Withdraw idle assets and take the rest in kind (as Morpho Blue supply positions) from an illiquid Vault V2.
Redeem in kind from an illiquid Vault V1.

offchainApis.name: Morpho Read API
offchainApis.use: REST reads for agents and apps: /v0/blue/markets (list, filter by chain_id), /v0/blue/markets/{market}/state, /liquidity, /public-allocator-vaults, /users/{address}/position; /v0/vaults-v1 and /v0/vaults-v2 lists, /v1/vaults-v2/{vault}/state (total_assets, share_price_ray, withdrawable_assets), /v0/vaults-v2/{vault}/allocations, user positions, /v0/tokens/{token}/price, /v0/oracles/{oracle}/state, Midnight books. Rate-limited without a key; OpenAPI at https://docs.morpho.org/openapi.json.

offchainApis.name: Morpho Actions API
offchainApis.use: Builds transaction calls (supply, borrow, vault deposit, etc.) for the user's wallet to sign. API key in the x-api-key header; action requests to api.morpho.org are refused (403).

offchainApis.name: Morpho GraphQL API (legacy)
offchainApis.use: Legacy GraphQL for markets, vaults and positions. Shuts down on January 29, 2027; use the Read API instead.

actions.name: find markets / vaults
actions.description: Discover markets and vaults (they are not listed one by one here)
actions.how: Read API GET https://api.morpho.org/v0/blue/markets?chain_id=1 or /v0/vaults-v2 (listed vaults). On-chain: CreateMarket events on Morpho give marketParams; idToMarketParams(id) returns them; VaultV2Factory.isVaultV2(addr) / MetaMorpho factory isMetaMorpho(addr) verify a vault is genuine.

actions.name: lend in a market
actions.description: Supply the loan token to one Morpho Blue market
actions.how: approve(Morpho, amount) on the loan token; Morpho.supply(marketParams, amount, 0, you, 0x). Or BlueBundlesV1.blueBundlesV1Supply(...).

actions.name: borrow
actions.description: Borrow against collateral in one market
actions.how: approve(Morpho) on collateral; Morpho.supplyCollateral(marketParams, collAmount, you, 0x); then Morpho.borrow(marketParams, amount, 0, you, you). Keep LTV well under LLTV. One tx: BlueBundlesV1.blueBundlesV1SupplyCollateralAndBorrow with a maxLtv guard (needs Morpho authorization for the bundle, by setAuthorization or signedAuthorization).

actions.name: repay and withdraw collateral
actions.how: approve(Morpho) on the loan token; Morpho.repay(marketParams, 0, position(id,you).borrowShares, you, 0x); Morpho.withdrawCollateral(marketParams, position.collateral, you, you).

actions.name: deposit into a vault
actions.how: Verify the vault with VaultV2Factory.isVaultV2 or isMetaMorpho; approve(vault, amount) on its asset(); vault.deposit(amount, you). Exit: vault.redeem(shares, you, you). Or VaultBundlesV1.vaultBundlesV1Deposit with a maxSharePriceE27 slippage guard.

actions.name: exit an illiquid Vault V2
actions.description: Get funds out when the vault's liquidity is allocated
actions.how: VaultExitBundlesV1.vaultExitBundlesV1ForceWithdrawVaultV2 (pays the forceDeallocate penalty) or vaultExitBundlesV1InKindRedemptionVaultV2 (take Blue supply positions in kind).

actions.name: source extra liquidity
actions.description: Borrow more than a market currently holds
actions.how: Check /v0/blue/markets/{id}/public-allocator-vaults, then BluePublicAllocator.reallocate(...) or pass reallocations to a BlueBundlesV1 entrypoint.

risks: Liquidation: if a borrower's LTV (debt / collateral valued by the market's oracle) exceeds the market's immutable LLTV, anyone can liquidate it and seize collateral with an incentive of up to 15% (MAX_LIQUIDATION_INCENTIVE_FACTOR 1.15; the incentive is larger for lower LLTVs).

Oracle risk: each market's oracle is fixed at creation and anyone can create markets with any oracle; a wrong or manipulable oracle can cause unfair liquidations or bad debt. Morpho's docs say no oracle is immune to manipulation; check the oracle (Read API /v0/oracles/{oracle}/state) before using a market.
Bad debt is realised immediately and socialised to that market's lenders (and to vaults allocated there). Markets are isolated, so losses stay in the affected market.
Liquidity risk: lenders can only withdraw what is not borrowed; at 100% utilisation withdrawals revert until borrowers repay (the AdaptiveCurveIrm raises rates sharply to restore liquidity).

Curator risk (vaults): Vault V1 curators/allocators and Vault V2 Owner/Curator/Allocators/Sentinels decide which markets and adapters the vault uses; a bad allocation means losses for depositors. Most risk-increasing changes are timelocked, gates can block deposits/withdrawals, and fees are capped (Vault V2: performance <= 50%, management <= 5%/yr). Check the vault's curator, timelock and allocations before depositing.
Vault V2 maxDeposit/maxMint/maxWithdraw/maxRedeem always return 0 by design; integrations that rely on these ERC-4626 limits will think the vault is closed.
Counterparty risk on assets: centralised loan or collateral tokens can be frozen or blacklisted by their issuer.

Smart-contract risk: Morpho Blue and the vault contracts are immutable (no admin upgrade); governance (MORPHO holders) can only enable new IRMs/LLTVs and set a fee switch (capped at 25% of interest). Bundler3 and its adapters are deprecated in favour of Bundles; existing deployments stay live but the Morpho app no longer uses them.
notes: Slug: DefiLlama lists Morpho as a parent protocol (api.llama.fi/protocol/morpho) whose main child is 'Morpho Blue' (slug morpho-blue), plus Morpho Midnight and the retired Morpho Optimizers; this file covers the Morpho family. All addresses are from the official docs page https://docs.morpho.org/developers/contracts/addresses (raw markdown at https://docs.morpho.org/developers/contracts/addresses.md) and every one was checked to have contract code (eth_getCode). The Morpho Blue singleton is 0xBBBBBbbBBb9cC5e90e3b3Af64bdAF62C37EEFFCb only on Ethereum and Base; on other chains it has a different address (listed). keyFunctions are given once on the Ethereum entries; same-named contracts elsewhere share the interface. Vault ERC-4626 functions are shown on the factory entries, marked '[On a Vault ...]', because individual vaults are not listed: find them with the Read API (/v0/vaults-v1, /v0/vaults-v2) and verify with isMetaMorpho / isVaultV2. Morpho is on about 40 chains (HyperEVM, Katana, Monad, Sonic, World Chain, Plasma, Sei, Stable, Tempo, Robinhood Chain, etc.); those, plus ChainlinkOracleV2 factories, MorphoRegistry, Vault V2 adapter factories, Universal Rewards Distributors, Bundler3 migration/Paraswap adapters, MidnightBundles, Midnight ratifiers/periphery and the legacy Morpho Optimizers, are on the addresses page but not listed here. The Vault V1 PublicAllocator is intentionally omitted: the docs say retired Vault V1 allocator addresses are left out and integrators should use the Vault V2 Blue Public Allocator. Midnight (fixed-rate, fixed-term order-book markets) is listed on Ethereum and Base without keyFunctions because its interface (offers, ratifiers, callbacks) is complex; use MidnightBundlesV2 and the Midnight docs (https://docs.morpho.org/developers/midnight/resources/all). Legacy MORPHO 0x9994E35Db50125E0DF82e4c2dde62496CE330999 is not transferable; only wrapped MORPHO is. Signatures come from Sourcify full/partial matches (Morpho, factories, Public Allocator, Bundles, MORPHO implementation) and morpho-org GitHub sources (vault-v2 IVaultV2/IERC4626, VaultV2.sol, metamorpho IMetaMorpho). No dated security incidents are included because none were found on an official Morpho page during research.
